name: Chiemgau Coaster
editorial: Eight descriptions rewritten to remove raw technical metrics and source jargon; official age and ticket rules structured; nine fare offers; thirty-four closed days 15 Nov–18 Dec 2026. Homepage supersedes stale price-page footer that says daily open.

calendar.nuance: Winter opening announced for 19 December but day-by-day opening still weather-dependent. No later dates marked open.

pricing: Price page has adult, child-driver and child-passenger 1/3/6 fares. Operator PDF labels current prices valid through November 2026, so nine offers are dated to 30 Nov 2026, with explicit winter recheck. Flat-rate prices and transfer rules are explained in notes.
